products.lede: Quiet from the front. Repetition down the back.
details: Black full zip hoodie, two way YKK zip
Small white KALOS embroidered at the left chest
White dry brush tri apex printed on the back
products.fabric: 80% cotton, 20% recycled polyester, cotton faced fleece. Heavyweight 11.8 oz, about 400 GSM. Oversized fit, dropped shoulders. Garment made in Bangladesh, decorated in Canada.
products.care: Machine wash cold, inside out, with like colours. No bleach, no tumble dry, no dry clean. Do not iron the print. Line dry in shade.
